lead.title: Nvidia takes a minority stake in Doctolib and will help it train its AI models
lead.deck: Announced on October 13 during Jensen Huang's visit to Paris, the stake, whose size is undisclosed, comes with Nvidia support for training Doctolib's models; Doctolib already launched a consultation assistant in 2024. Three other French startups are included: Genesis AI, Pigment and Entalpic.

milestone.title: NHS England plans an £838.7M open framework for GP software
milestone.summary: It will replace the expired GP IT Futures framework and cover a broader range of clinical and operational software for primary care. The tender is expected to start in November 2026 and the framework to launch on September 20, 2027 (notice 094419-2026 on Find a Tender).
milestone.why: For UK health software vendors, this is the next big buying window in primary care. DXS, which issued the press release, cites an 81.7% increase in central funding; no supplier has been selected yet.

brefsEurope.title: UK commission on AI in healthcare recommends lifecycle regulation of AI medical devices
brefsEurope.summary: Its 119-page report makes 44 non-binding recommendations: review of the Medical Devices Regulations 2002, staged authorization, stronger post-market surveillance and a public incident database. The government said on October 6 that it would accept all of them.

word.full: AI Airlock (the MHRA's regulatory sandbox for AI medical devices)
word.fr: UK regulatory sandbox for medical AI
word.definition: An MHRA programme that has innovators test AI medical devices in a controlled setting to identify regulatory obstacles and draw lessons, without the force of formal guidance.

parts.label: Regulatory challenges
parts.role: the questions put to the test

how.t: Phase 2 picked seven technologies from 51 applicants.
Products are tested on three challenges: intended purpose and validation, AI-powered in vitro diagnostics, and post-market surveillance with a predetermined change control plan.
Lessons are published in programme reports, the latest dated July 27, 2026, which do not constitute formal guidance.

word.why: For a VC, going through the sandbox is a signal of an AI startup's regulatory maturity, and the third phase will focus on lifecycle surveillance, exactly what the UK commission published this week recommends.
